title: Areas of smoke remaining on Thursday with a slight shift
snippet: Wildfire smoke will remain in the conversation for many areas of Colorado on Thursday and Friday. There is a bit of difference between the source of smoke for different areas, yet the outcome is much the same. Let's go through it all. Western and southwestern Colorado will continue to receive smoke from fires in Utah and Nevada. The Elk and Rio Blanco fires in Colorado will also add smoke to the mix.
